comments_text: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that this sequence is most similar (89.47%) to GF-17 GF-19 = GF-17 + KL. Activity: it inhibited herpes simplex virus serotype I (HSV-1). MOA:virus: probably block viral entry.
title: Modified host defence peptide GF19 slows TNT-mediated spread of corneal herpes simplex virus serotype I infection.
